argv:
t=$(readlink -f /mnt/bko-target) || exit 1; want=vos-b; ilv=vos--root-init; iuuid=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008; errs=; nbad=0
err() { errs="${errs}abroot: $*
"; nbad=$((nbad + 1)); }
g=$t/boot/grub/grub.cfg
[ -f "$g" ] || { echo "abroot: boot/grub/grub.cfg isn't on the restored /boot" >&2; exit 1; }
d=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*set[[:space:]][[:space:]]*default=\([0-9][0-9]*\)[[:space:]]*$/\1/p' "$g" | head -n 1)
set -- $(awk '$1 == "configfile" { p = $2; gsub(/"/, "", p); sub(/^\([^)]*\)/, "", p); sub(/^\//, "", p); sub(/\/.*$/, "", p); print p }' "$g")
[ $# -eq 2 ] || err "grub.cfg has $# configfile lines, not 2"
case $d in 0) dl=${1:-} ;; 1) dl=${2:-} ;; *) dl=; err "grub.cfg has no set default=0 or 1${d:+ (it has default=$d)}" ;; esac
[ -z "$dl" ] || [ "$dl" = "$want" ] || err "grub.cfg's default entry ($d) leads to $dl, the dump's to $want (a backup taken across an upgrade's grub.cfg swap?)"
for r in $(awk '$1 == "set" && $2 ~ /^root=\(lvm\// { sub(/^root=/, "", $2); print $2 }' "$g"); do
  [ "$r" = "(lvm/$ilv)" ] || err "grub.cfg sets root=$r, not (lvm/$ilv), the init LV"
done
chk() {
  L=$1; c=$t/boot/init/$L/abroot.cfg
  if [ ! -f "$c" ]; then
    if [ "$2" = 1 ]; then
      echo "abroot: warning: $L was empty on the source (no usr/, no init/$L/abroot.cfg): restored empty, its grub.cfg entry boots nothing, as on the source" >&2
      [ "$L" != "$dl" ] || err "grub.cfg's default entry leads to $L, which is empty"
    else
      err "$L: init/$L/abroot.cfg isn't on the restored init LV"
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # The first linux line whose kernel is in /$L/, its root=, the first
  # initrd after it, and the last search --fs-uuid before it in its block
  # (an upgrade's abroot.cfg is a whole generated GRUB config: its
  # 00_header can search for the font's filesystem first).
  v=$(awk -v L="$L" '
    $1 == "menuentry" || $1 == "submenu" || $1 == "}" { s = "" }
    $1 == "search" { s = ""; for (j = 2; j < NF; j++) if ($j == "--fs-uuid" || $j == "-u") s = $NF }
    k == "" && $1 == "linux" { p = $2; sub(/^\([^)]*\)/, "", p); if (index(p, "/" L "/") == 1) { k = $2; u = s; for (j = 3; j <= NF; j++) if ($j ~ /^root=/) { r = $j; sub(/^root=/, "", r); break } }; next }
    k != "" && i == "" && $1 == "initrd" { i = $2 }
    END { print k; print i; print r; print u }' "$c")
  k=$(printf '%s\n' "$v" | sed -n 1p); i=$(printf '%s\n' "$v" | sed -n 2p); r=$(printf '%s\n' "$v" | sed -n 3p); u=$(printf '%s\n' "$v" | sed -n 4p)
  [ -n "$k" ] || { err "$L: abroot.cfg has no linux line with a kernel in init/$L/"; return 0; }
  [ -n "$i" ] || err "$L: abroot.cfg has no initrd line after its linux line"
  for p in $k $i; do
    f=${p#\(*\)}
    case $f in "/$L/"*) [ -f "$t/boot/init$f" ] || err "$L: abroot.cfg's $p isn't on the restored init LV" ;; *) err "$L: abroot.cfg's $p isn't in init/$L/" ;; esac
  done
  case $r in
    "") err "$L: abroot.cfg's linux line has no root=" ;;
    "UUID=$3"|"/dev/mapper/$4"|"$5") ;;
    *) err "$L: abroot.cfg's root=$r isn't $L's filesystem (UUID=$3, /dev/mapper/$4 or $5)" ;;
  esac
  [ -z "$u" ] || [ "$u" = "$iuuid" ] || err "$L: abroot.cfg searches for the filesystem $u, not the init LV's ($iuuid)"
}
chk vos-a 0 bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000c vos--root-root--a /dev/vos-root/root-a
chk vos-b 0 bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000e vos--root-root--b /dev/vos-root/root-b
[ -z "$errs" ] || { printf %s "$errs" >&2; echo "abroot: $nbad mismatches between grub.cfg, the init LV and the roots in the restored tree (a backup taken across an upgrade?)" >&2; exit 1; }
echo "abroot: grub.cfg boots $dl by default; each root's abroot.cfg leads to its kernel, initramfs and filesystem"

# bko-holt load plan for layout.json
# Source: host2, Vanilla OS 3.0, UEFI boot with grub, dumped 2026-11-14T07:26:40Z

# Disks:

# ---- partition ----

wipefs --all /dev/sdq
# /dev/sdq: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sdq) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sdq, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# vda1: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2048 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2097152 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda2: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2099200 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=3145728 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda3: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=3147776 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=49494016 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda4: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=49496064 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=134213632 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sdq before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sdq <<'EOF'
label: gpt
label-id: bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512
table-length: 128
first-lba: 34
last-lba: 134217694

/dev/sdq1 : start=2048, size=2097152, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002, name="vos-boot"
/dev/sdq2 : start=2099200, size=1048576, type=C12A7328-F81F-11D2-BA4B-00A0C93EC93B, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005, name="vos-efi"
/dev/sdq3 : start=3147776, size=46348288, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006, name="vos-root"
/dev/sdq4 : start=49496064, size=84719616, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007, name="vos-var"
EOF
udevadm settle

mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt/lvm

			creation_time = 1794636129

# ---- format ----
# vda1: ext4 "vos-boot"
mke2fs -F -q -t ext4 -O none,has_journal,ext_attr,resize_inode,dir_index,orphan_file,filetype,extent,64bit,flex_bg,metadata_csum_seed,sparse_super,large_file,huge_file,dir_nlink,extra_isize,metadata_csum -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003 -L vos-boot -b 4096 -I 256 -N 65536 -g 32768 -G 16 -E hash_seed=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004,desc_size=64,resize=268435456 /dev/sdq1 1048576k
tune2fs -r 13107 /dev/sdq1

# vda2: vfat "vos-efi"
mkfs.fat -F 32 -i BC000001 -n vos-efi -S 512 -s 8 -f 2 -R 32 -h 2099200 -M 0xf8 /dev/sdq2
# check: /dev/sdq2 is vfat with the source's FAT size, sector and cluster size (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# dm-0: ext4 "vos-init"
mke2fs -F -q -t ext4 -O none,has_journal,ext_attr,resize_inode,dir_index,orphan_file,filetype,extent,64bit,flex_bg,metadata_csum_seed,sparse_super,large_file,huge_file,dir_nlink,extra_isize,metadata_csum -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008 -L vos-init -b 4096 -I 256 -N 65536 -g 32768 -G 16 -E hash_seed=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009,desc_size=64,resize=268435456 /dev/mapper/vos--root-init 1048576k

mkfs.btrfs -f -O extref,skinny-metadata,no-holes,^raid56,^raid1c34,^zoned,^squota,free-space-tree,block-group-tree -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000e -L vos-b --csum crc32c -n 16384 -s 4096 -d single -m dup --device-uuid bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000f /dev/mapper/vos--root-root--b
# check: /dev/mapper/vos--root-root--b is btrfs with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)

# ---- mount ----
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target
mount -t btrfs -o defaults /dev/mapper/vos--root-root--b /mnt/bko-target

mount -t ext4 -o noatime,errors=remount-ro /dev/sdq1 /mnt/bko-target/boot

# ---- restore ----
# snapshot latest of /srv/bko-repo, with BackOtter's restore flags
RUSTIC_STRICT_EXIT=true rustic-bko --repository /srv/bko-repo --no-progress restore --numeric-id latest /mnt/bko-target
# the atimes the restore set, for boot to put back after its reads
sh -c 'mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before'

# ---- boot ----
# refuses to start unless /mnt/bko-target/abimage.abr is there: the restored present root
# the restored atimes (the restore stage lists them), to put back after this stage's reads
sh -c '[ -s /run/bko-holt/atimes.before ] || { mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before; }'
# ABRoot: /boot (the master grub.cfg), the ESP, the init LV and both roots are restored as they were; no initramfs, no grub-install, no update-grub (a failing stub on Vanilla OS), no chroot
# the master grub.cfg's default entry leads to the dump's root, and each root's abroot.cfg to its kernel, initramfs and filesystem, in the restored tree
sh -c 't=$(readlink -f /mnt/bko-target) || exit 1; want=vos-b; ilv=vos--root-init; iuuid=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008; errs=; nbad=0
err() { errs="${errs}abroot: $*
"; nbad=$((nbad + 1)); }
g=$t/boot/grub/grub.cfg
[ -f "$g" ] || { echo "abroot: boot/grub/grub.cfg isn'\''t on the restored /boot" >&2; exit 1; }
d=$(sed -n '\''s/^[[:space:]]*set[[:space:]][[:space:]]*default=\([0-9][0-9]*\)[[:space:]]*$/\1/p'\'' "$g" | head -n 1)
set -- $(awk '\''$1 == "configfile" { p = $2; gsub(/"/, "", p); sub(/^\([^)]*\)/, "", p); sub(/^\//, "", p); sub(/\/.*$/, "", p); print p }'\'' "$g")
[ $# -eq 2 ] || err "grub.cfg has $# configfile lines, not 2"
case $d in 0) dl=${1:-} ;; 1) dl=${2:-} ;; *) dl=; err "grub.cfg has no set default=0 or 1${d:+ (it has default=$d)}" ;; esac
[ -z "$dl" ] || [ "$dl" = "$want" ] || err "grub.cfg'\''s default entry ($d) leads to $dl, the dump'\''s to $want (a backup taken across an upgrade'\''s grub.cfg swap?)"
for r in $(awk '\''$1 == "set" && $2 ~ /^root=\(lvm\// { sub(/^root=/, "", $2); print $2 }'\'' "$g"); do
  [ "$r" = "(lvm/$ilv)" ] || err "grub.cfg sets root=$r, not (lvm/$ilv), the init LV"
done
chk() {
  L=$1; c=$t/boot/init/$L/abroot.cfg
  if [ ! -f "$c" ]; then
    if [ "$2" = 1 ]; then
      echo "abroot: warning: $L was empty on the source (no usr/, no init/$L/abroot.cfg): restored empty, its grub.cfg entry boots nothing, as on the source" >&2
      [ "$L" != "$dl" ] || err "grub.cfg'\''s default entry leads to $L, which is empty"
    else
      err "$L: init/$L/abroot.cfg isn'\''t on the restored init LV"
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # The first linux line whose kernel is in /$L/, its root=, the first
  # initrd after it, and the last search --fs-uuid before it in its block
  # (an upgrade'\''s abroot.cfg is a whole generated GRUB config: its
  # 00_header can search for the font'\''s filesystem first).
  v=$(awk -v L="$L" '\''
    $1 == "menuentry" || $1 == "submenu" || $1 == "}" { s = "" }
    $1 == "search" { s = ""; for (j = 2; j < NF; j++) if ($j == "--fs-uuid" || $j == "-u") s = $NF }
    k == "" && $1 == "linux" { p = $2; sub(/^\([^)]*\)/, "", p); if (index(p, "/" L "/") == 1) { k = $2; u = s; for (j = 3; j <= NF; j++) if ($j ~ /^root=/) { r = $j; sub(/^root=/, "", r); break } }; next }
    k != "" && i == "" && $1 == "initrd" { i = $2 }
    END { print k; print i; print r; print u }'\'' "$c")
  k=$(printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$v" | sed -n 1p); i=$(printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$v" | sed -n 2p); r=$(printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$v" | sed -n 3p); u=$(printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$v" | sed -n 4p)
  [ -n "$k" ] || { err "$L: abroot.cfg has no linux line with a kernel in init/$L/"; return 0; }
  [ -n "$i" ] || err "$L: abroot.cfg has no initrd line after its linux line"
  for p in $k $i; do
    f=${p#\(*\)}
    case $f in "/$L/"*) [ -f "$t/boot/init$f" ] || err "$L: abroot.cfg'\''s $p isn'\''t on the restored init LV" ;; *) err "$L: abroot.cfg'\''s $p isn'\''t in init/$L/" ;; esac
  done
  case $r in
    "") err "$L: abroot.cfg'\''s linux line has no root=" ;;
    "UUID=$3"|"/dev/mapper/$4"|"$5") ;;
    *) err "$L: abroot.cfg'\''s root=$r isn'\''t $L'\''s filesystem (UUID=$3, /dev/mapper/$4 or $5)" ;;
  esac
  [ -z "$u" ] || [ "$u" = "$iuuid" ] || err "$L: abroot.cfg searches for the filesystem $u, not the init LV'\''s ($iuuid)"
}
chk vos-a 0 bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000c vos--root-root--a /dev/vos-root/root-a
chk vos-b 0 bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000e vos--root-root--b /dev/vos-root/root-b
[ -z "$errs" ] || { printf %s "$errs" >&2; echo "abroot: $nbad mismatches between grub.cfg, the init LV and the roots in the restored tree (a backup taken across an upgrade?)" >&2; exit 1; }
echo "abroot: grub.cfg boots $dl by default; each root'\''s abroot.cfg leads to its kernel, initramfs and filesystem"
'

bash -c 'find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.after && LC_ALL=C comm -z -23 /run/bko-holt/atimes.before /run/bko-holt/atimes.after | \
             while IFS=$'\''\t'\'' read -r -d '\'''\'' a p; do [ -L "$p" ] || [ -e "$p" ] || continue; touch -a -h -d "@$a" -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || { [ ! -L "$p" ] && lsattr -d -- "$p" 2>/dev/null | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1 | grep -q i && { chattr -i -- "$p"; touch -a -h -d "@$a" -- "$p"; chattr +i -- "$p"; }; }; done'
